lento-proclamations.hears: The proud held tones of the opening declamation, tutti, C# minor: C#4 (3.37), the C# chord (5.54-5.88), B minor (10.3), E4-D4-C#4 (13.0-13.7), the C# octaves (15.8), down to the Ab/A sighs of 22-36 s. Few, long, ff.
lento-proclamations.rule: voiced line of pack notes >= 0.28 s, midi >= 50, 3.3-40.4 s

long-tones.hears: The long, slow notes (held 1.5 s or more): the Lento's held chords, the lassan's sustained tones, the dissolve. For handovers and slow morphs.
long-tones.rule: pack notes held >= 1.5 s with velocity >= 55; of each cluster the loudest

melody-all.hears: The voiced-out tune of the whole piece, one held note at a time: the declamations, the lassan theme, the songs, the friska tune. An always-on thread.
melody-all.rule: voiced line of pack notes >= 0.28 s, midi >= 55 (and >= 0.15 s in the friska from 385 s), minus the dissolve

lento-knocks.hears: The knocking ornament of the Lento, a cimbalom figure: the grace notes of the very first gesture (3.4-3.7 s), then B3-C#4-B3-B4 struck fast, four to eight times (8.3-8.9, 18.3-18.9, 21.1-21.8 s and again at 178.6-179.2, 181.4-182.3, 189.0-189.5, 191.1-192.6, 202.1-204.1 s). Its reprise is the sign that the Lento is back.
lento-knocks.rule: pack notes < 0.35 s in Lento I and II that sit in a group of >= 4 short notes each <= 0.2 s after the last

cello-line.hears: The cellos' line from the bottom (YourMT3+ lane, 1802 notes): the lassan theme's voice at 40-56 and 212-236 s, the friska's bass.
cello-line.rule: lowest roll cello note of each cluster, >= 0.2 s, >= 0.15 s apart

viola-inner.hears: The violas' inner line (YourMT3+ lane): the middle voice of the tutti, held notes.
viola-inner.rule: voiced line of roll viola notes >= 0.2 s

violin-line.hears: The violins' top line wherever YourMT3+ hears them (2039 notes; thick in 56-92, 131-160, 216-250, 385-575 s; empty in 307-384 and 584-604 s).
violin-line.rule: skyline of roll violin notes >= 0.15 s

bass-all.hears: The bass of the whole piece, one note at least 0.4 s after the last: the Lento's tolls, the lassan's roots, the dissolve's low strings, the friska's oom-pah and blows.
bass-all.rule: lowest pack note below midi 50, >= 0.2 s, >= 0.4 s apart

lento-strokes.hears: The bass strokes under the declamation: B1 (5.65), F#1/A1 (10.4), C#1 (15.85), F1 (26.3), E1 (30.9), Ab1 (37.65), F#1 (39.9), and in the reprise Ab1 (175.9), C#1 (176.1), F#1 (180.9), A1 (190.9), E1 (201.7), Ab1 (209.2). Single deep tolls, several seconds apart.
lento-strokes.rule: lowest note of pack clusters in Lento I and II with a note below midi 46 and velocity >= 60, >= 0.6 s apart

lassan-bass.hears: The bass under the lassan theme: the C#2/Ab1 roots, F#2-C#2 steps and the Ab2 pedal of 212-216 s. Slow, one note every second or two.
lassan-bass.rule: lowest pack note below midi 50, >= 0.2 s, >= 0.35 s apart, in 40.4-92.5 and 212.4-251.5 s

lassan-theme-cellos.hears: The brooding lassan theme alone in the low strings, p (A2-Ab2-B2-Ab2 ... down to C#2, then the C#3/Ab2 rocking of 52-56 s): the darkest, quietest statement.
lassan-theme-cellos.rule: skyline of pack notes >= 0.2 s, 40.4-56 s

repeats.hears: The repeated notes, top or bottom of the texture: the Lento's B3 knocks, the G#4 taps (104-112 s), the dance's G#2 drone, the dissolve's C#3 and Ab1, the friska's pounded C#s and the prestissimo's C#3.
repeats.rule: repeats() on the top and the bottom note of each pack cluster: one pitch struck >= 5 times in a row, each 0.08-0.4 s after the last

lassan-theme-strings.hears: The lassan theme taken up by the whole string body from the sudden f at 56.0 s: C#4 repeated, Eb4-E4, rising to Ab4/E5 (76-80 s) and A5 (83.5 s), the climb to the ff of 88-92 s.
lassan-theme-strings.rule: voiced line of pack notes >= 0.28 s, midi >= 52, 56-92.5 s

ff-blows.hears: Every real ff blow of the piece: full chords of 3+ notes at velocity 105+ that reach into the bass (the friska tuttis at 411-420, 480-500, 536-570 s, the stretta and the last chords). The set for Fireworks.
ff-blows.rule: pack clusters with >= 3 notes, loudest >= 105 and a note below midi 50; lowest and highest note

lassan-ff-peaks.hears: The accented chords at the tops of the two big lassan crescendi (76-92 s and 236-251 s): ff, heavy, a few seconds apart.
lassan-ff-peaks.rule: pack clusters in 56-92.5 and 236-251.5 s with >= 2 notes and loudest >= 99; lowest and highest note

clarinet-all.hears: Every clarinet note (154): the two cadenzas (93-100, 253-262 s), the garlands of 110-131 s, the sinking of 166-173 s and the friska's dawn (368-377 s). The solo voice of the piece.

clarinet-cadenza-1.hears: After the ff breaks off (92.5 s), the clarinet alone: a soft flourish rising G4-Bb4-C#5-Eb5-G5-Bb5 to C#6/Eb6 (95-96 s) and winding down to B4 (99.6 s), the cimbalom imitated by a wind.

runs.hears: The fast scales and flourishes: the clarinet cadenzas, the glitter, the descending octave runs and rushing scales of the friska.
runs.rule: runs() on the cluster tops: >= 5 successive attacks <= 0.16 s apart, steps of 1-4 semitones in one direction (one turn allowed)

cadenza-hush-knocks.hears: Five soft re-touches of a held B4 (-26 to -32 dB) in the hush after the cadenza, where the transcription has nothing (100.2-103.3 s).

gsharp-repeats.hears: A quiet G#4 tapped again and again (104.0-112.0 s, p), the pivot from the lassan into the lighter G# major interlude.

interlude-line.hears: The interlude's singing line in G# major (Ab4-C5-Eb4-C4 arpeggios, B4-Ab4, C#5-E5): gentle, mid-high.
interlude-line.rule: voiced line of pack notes >= 0.2 s, midi >= 56, 103.9-131 s

clarinet-garlands.hears: The clarinet's garlands over the strings, F#5-A5-B5 turns and falling Eb5-B4 figures (113-131 s), p.

dance-lilt.hears: The lilting dance: strings and winds in a swaying G#-major tune that speeds up (pulse 0.53 s at 132 s, 0.41 s at 156 s), Eb5-C#5-Ab4 and C5-Bb4-Ab4 figures.
dance-lilt.rule: voiced line of pack notes >= 0.2 s, midi >= 56, 131-160 s, outside the glitter (136.5-147.5 s notes >= C6 excluded)

dance-pedal.hears: The G#2 drone under the dance (the plucked/pizzicato Ab2 every half second at 135-137 s, then every second or so): a steady low pulse.
dance-pedal.rule: lowest pack note below midi 50, >= 0.3 s apart, 131-160 s

glitter-1.hears: The first glitter: high sparkles flicked up to E7/Eb7 (140.3-140.6 s) and A6/Ab6 (142-147 s), loud and brief, the cimbalom's top.

high-alternation.hears: C#6 and Eb6 alternating high and loud (160-165 s), a slow shake before the music sinks.

clarinet-sinking.hears: The clarinet sinking from C6 down to C#4 and circling C#4-F4-Eb4 three times, pp (166.0-172.5 s), the last breath before the Lento returns.

lento-proclamations-return.hears: The opening declamation again, tutti, the same phrases 170.5 s later (C#4 174.4, B minor 180.75, E4-D4-C#4 183.3-184.1, the C# octaves 186.2), then the Ab4 calls of 200-204 s.
lento-proclamations-return.rule: voiced line of pack notes >= 0.28 s, midi >= 50, 173.9-212.4 s

lassan-theme-return.hears: The lassan theme back in the low strings, now f (Ab2 pedal, then C#3-E3, B2-E3-Ab3), climbing from 236 s to C#5 and the ff.
lassan-theme-return.rule: voiced line of pack notes >= 0.28 s, 212.4-246.4 s

climax-strokes.hears: The lassan climax: a Bb1 diminished chord (246.5), G/E (247), the Ab chord (248.0), Ab1 (249.3) and the A1/A2 blow (250.5, the loudest moment of the lassan), cut off at 251.5 s into silence.
climax-strokes.rule: pack clusters 246.4-251.5 s; lowest and highest note

clarinet-cadenza-2.hears: The second cadenza after the climax cut-off: the clarinet rises by step G3-A3-Bb3 ... D5-Eb5-F5 to Ab5 (253.0-255.5 s) and trills Ab5-A5 slowly to 261.5 s, very soft.
clarinet-cadenza-2.rule: roll clarinet notes and pack notes >= G3, 252.9-262 s, lane doubles merged

a-major-song.hears: A tender song in A major/F# minor in the violins, p (A4-C#5-A4, up to C#6/Eb6 at 267-270 s, then Ab5-E5, C#5-A4 phrases): the lassan's one lyrical patch.
a-major-song.rule: voiced line of pack notes >= 0.28 s, midi >= 57, 264.5-307 s

a-major-bass.hears: The soft bass of the song: E2, F#2, A2, C#3, a note every few seconds.
a-major-bass.rule: lowest pack note below midi 52, >= 0.2 s, >= 0.5 s apart, 264.5-307 s

harp-arpeggio.hears: The rolled chords that colour the song (A-C#-E at 290.3-292.8 s, C5-C#5-Eb5-E5 at 293.2-294.1, A major at 301.9, F# minor at 303.0): harp-like, soft.
harp-arpeggio.rule: roll piano and plucked notes 290-304 s (YourMT3+ labels; the sound is a plucked/keyboard colour)

dissolve-murmur.hears: The lassan dissolving: pp low strings (-25 to -34 dB), B2-D3-F#3 and C#3-E3 chords, the C#3 repeated at 332-338 s, then the Ab1 shudder of 344-355 s. The lanes are empty here (only a few cello notes): use this set, not a track.
dissolve-murmur.rule: pack notes 307-355.5 s, of each cluster the lowest

dissolve-audio.hears: The faintest touches of the dissolve as the microphone hears them (308-330 s, -27 to -36 dB): low F#3/A2/C#3 and stray high A4/B4. For widgets that must keep breathing where the notes are 1-3 a second.

dominant-swell.hears: The swell on C# (the dominant of F#): F1/F3, C#2 strokes rising to -16 dB at 357.5 s, then fading out to the grand pause (361.5-363.4 s, -44 dB, true silence).
dominant-swell.rule: pack notes 355-358 s and audio onsets 355.5-361.5 s where the pack has none within 0.12 s

friska-dawn.hears: The friska begins pp, high and light: the clarinet (and high winds) tapping the F# minor tune, Ab5-F#5-C#6-A5 staccato, F#6/A6 points (363.6-384.8 s). The first 5 s have no transcribed notes: these are the audio's onsets.
friska-dawn.rule: pack notes >= C5 (72) 363.4-385 s, with audio onsets filled in where the pack has none within 0.12 s

friska-strings-theme.hears: The violins take the friska tune (from 385.0 s): the staccato C#5 struck over and over, every ~0.2 s, with A4/F#4/Ab4 dips and Ab5-A5 leaps (391-395 s), growing from p to f as F# minor turns to F# major (399-405 s).
friska-strings-theme.rule: skyline of roll violin notes >= 0.05 s, 385-410.4 s; pack notes >= C4 fill 385-387 s and gaps of 0.12 s

friska-vamp-bass.hears: The friska's oom-pah bass, C#3/F#2/A3 alternating with the chords: the dance's legs, a note every half second.
friska-vamp-bass.rule: lowest pack note below midi 55, >= 0.25 s apart, 385-410.4 and 421-480.6 s

cimbalom-tremolo.hears: The cimbalom tremolo, a chord shaken fast (every ~0.15 s): C#-Ab-F#-Bb chords at 407.6-409.5 s, just before the first tutti, and an Eb3/Ab3 shimmer at 522.3-524 s in the dip.

tutti-1-blows.hears: The first friska tutti in F# major, ff: full chords hammered from C#1/Bb0 to F6 (410.5-420.5 s), about one a second.
tutti-1-blows.rule: pack clusters 410.4-421 s with >= 3 notes and loudest >= 90; lowest and highest note

deep-tolls.hears: The deepest blows of the friska, Bb0/C#1/Bb1 struck under the tutti chords (411-420, 484-500, 536-570 s, and the last chords 620-627 s). Ff, the floor shaking.
deep-tolls.rule: lowest pack note <= C#2 (37) with velocity >= 80, >= 0.3 s apart, 410-628 s

friska-violins.hears: The violins' line through the friska proper, on the roll: the tune's neighbour-note shake, its staccato repeats, the whirls and the stomps' top (421-570 s). The friska's continuous melodic thread.
friska-violins.rule: skyline of roll violin notes >= 0.08 s, 421-570.4 s

friska-offbeats.hears: The off-beat chords under the tune (the "pah" of oom-pah), mid register, light and regular.
friska-offbeats.rule: pack clusters 421-456 s with >= 3 notes between midi 49 and 79; lowest and highest note

friska-tune.hears: The friska tune proper in F# major, light (p-mf): the violins' C6-C#6 neighbour-note shake (C#6-C6-C#6-C6-Eb6), F#6 and Bb5 answers (421-438 s).
friska-tune.rule: skyline of pack notes >= 0.1 s, midi >= 72, 421-438 s

glitter-2.hears: The friska's glitter: the tune flicked up to Eb7/F#7 (438-453 s), bright high points over the dance.

voice-line-friska.hears: A falling wind line (Eb4-C#4-C#4-E4-Bb4-Ab4-F#4-E4-Eb4-C#4, 446.7-452.4 s) answering the glitter.
voice-line-friska.rule: roll voice notes 446-453 s (a YourMT3+ "voice" label: a woodwind line, label unsure)

build-2-line.hears: The second build: the tune restarted p at 456 s (B4-Ab4-F4, C#5-Bb4), climbing to F6/Eb6 by 474-479 s.
build-2-line.rule: skyline of pack notes >= 0.15 s, midi >= 60, 456-480.6 s

dominant-pedal.hears: The G# pedal that holds the second build in suspense (468-480 s): a low note insisting before the stomp.
dominant-pedal.rule: pack notes Ab2 (G#2, midi 44) and Ab1 (32) 466-480.6 s

stomp-blows.hears: The stomping tutti, ff (480.6-500.4 s, peak at 488 s): hammered chords on Bb1/C#2, two a second.
stomp-blows.rule: pack clusters 480.6-500.4 s with >= 3 notes and loudest >= 100; lowest and highest note

brass-descents.hears: Two brass descents in octaves through the tutti: Bb-F-Ab-F#-F-E-Eb (487.8-489.4 s) and C#-B-A-Ab-F#-E (551.1-552.6 s).

high-whirl.hears: The violins whirling at the top, F#6-C#7-Eb7-Bb6-F#7 (500.4-510 s), loud and fast, after the stomp.

dip-line.hears: The sudden p after the whirl (510.3 s): the tune murmured mid-register (C#4-B3-Bb3, Ab3-F3-G3), gathering speed (pulse 0.34 to 0.31 s) towards the fireworks.
dip-line.rule: skyline of pack notes >= 0.12 s, midi >= 55, 510.3-526.5 s

fireworks.hears: The burst at the top: the highest notes of the piece, single notes flung F7-Ab6-F#7-Eb7-C7-G7 (527.0-534 s), ff. A spray of sparks, not chord blows (for Fireworks use the chord-blow sets).

plunge.hears: The plunge from the top to the bass: Ab2-Bb1-G1-Eb2-A1, F2-C1 (533.5-539 s), the floor reached before the loudest stomp.
plunge.rule: lowest pack note below midi 52, >= 0.15 s apart, 533.5-539.5 s

loudest-stomp-blows.hears: The loudest stretch of the piece (539.4-570.4 s, -1 to -8 dB): tutti chords stamped on C#2/Bb1, A major and E major swerves at 546-562 s, then the C# hammering of 564-570 s.
loudest-stomp-blows.rule: pack clusters 539.4-570.4 s with >= 3 notes and loudest >= 100, >= 0.3 s after the last kept; lowest and highest note

stomp-bursts.hears: Three bursts inside the stomp, every ~0.1 s: octave chords stepping down C#-E-B-A-Ab-G over a C# pedal (557.0-557.9 s), D octaves then an A chord pounded (559.1-560.4 s), and the A-major chord hammered (563.0-563.9 s).
stomp-bursts.rule: roll clusters 557.0-558.0, 559.0-560.5 and 563.0-564.0 s (the dense bursts, 47-73 notes a second); of each the lowest and highest note

high-tremolo.hears: The violins' high C#7-Eb7 (and F7) tremolo after the stomp breaks off (570.4 s), dying away from -13 to -28 dB by 583.6 s: the place of the cadenza, a shimmer thinning out.

prestissimo-repeats.hears: The prestissimo begins pp: the A4-C#5 and B4-C#5 alternations repeated fast (584-602 s), mid-high, a whisper that keeps accelerating. The lanes are empty here: use this set.

prestissimo-bass.hears: The C#3 repeated under the prestissimo (with F#2): a dry pulse.
prestissimo-bass.rule: pack notes below F#3 (54) in 584-605.6 s

stretta-chords.hears: The final stretta: chords rising from pp (605.6 s) to ff (612-619 s), F#2/C#2 bass, B5/C#5/Bb5 repeated at the top.
stretta-chords.rule: pack clusters 605.6-619.6 s with >= 3 notes; lowest and highest note

final-chords.hears: The last blows: the B chord at 619.0 s, a rest, the Bb0/A1 blow at 620.5 s (held to 622), C#3 strokes (622.5-623) and the F# major chords at 624.5-627.0 s. The sound ends at 628 s.
final-chords.rule: pack clusters 618.9-628 s; lowest and highest note
